Every concept below is OWNED by WEB06 (persisted in PostgreSQL; layout stored as JSONB).
VIS04 introduces NO new domain concept: it reads the ACTIVE configuration through
GET /kitchen-configurations/active and maps MaterialProperties and resolved KitchenAssets
to 3D rendering materials. Only the concepts relevant to materials and textures are shown.
